verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs say scans run automatically when merge requests are created and that security findings appear directly in merge requests before code is merged. The merge request changes view also shows inline annotations on changed lines, which delivers the story within GitLab. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detail on how findings are presented as MR checks or blocking status and which tiers include it, and any GitHub pull-request integration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can see scan findings surfaced as pull-request comments or checks in GitHub or GitLab

citations.quote: Security findings appear directly in merge requests and IDEs, notifying developers before code is merged.
Merge request changes view: Shows inline annotations for changed lines.
scans run automatically as part of CI/CD pipelines when code is committed or merge requests are created.
